Hi Tom / Sarah -

Thanks - appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming Tue Feb 27 09:00 PT for the technical call. I've attached the Redwood SP metadata and our SCIM provisioning guide to this message to help your team review ahead of the call.

Quick answers to your questions:
- SAML: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We prefer SP-initiated for login UX control, but IdP-initiated is fully supported. Attached: redwood_sso_metadata.xml (SP metadata) which includes AssertionConsumerService endpoints and our signing cert fingerprint.
- SCIM: We support SCIM v2 provisioning (PUT/POST/DELETE) with group push. Endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/
  - Token type: Bearer token (long-lived service token). We recommend rotating every 90 days; tokens can be revoked via the Console.
  - Supported attributes: userName (email), givenName, familyName, displayName, active (boolean), emails, groups. Groups are mapped to RBAC roles on our side (see mapping file attached).
- RBAC & admin controls: Built-in roles = owner, admin, developer, viewer. Owners can delegate admin rights; all admin actions are recorded in audit logs which we can provide as read-only exports for your auditors.

Attachments included here:
- redwood_sso_metadata.xml (SP metadata)
- scim_provisioning_guide.pdf (endpoints, example payloads, error codes)
- scim_attribute_mapping.csv (mapping between SCIM groups -> Redwood roles)

Next actions
1) Can you share Okta metadata (IdP) or confirm you'll consume our SP metadata?
2) Please open a vendor security questionnaire if you have one; otherwise we can pre-fill a standard one and send it back to you.
3) We'll run a SCIM test on the call (provision a test user) and confirm group -> role mapping.

See you Tue at 09:00 PT. Adding David (solutions) and Aditya (engineering) to the follow-up call.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: RE: IAM evidence request: SSO/SAML & SCIM - technical details for tomorrow

Hi Tom / Sarah -

Quick technical notes ahead of tomorrow's 09:00 PT call so we can hit the ground running:

SAML (high level) - SP metadata (attached by Marissa) contains:
  - AssertionConsumerService URL: https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/acs
  - EntityID: urn:redwood:sp:prod
  - WantAssertionsSigned: true
  - NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
  - Suggested attributes to map: email, firstName, lastName, groups (multi-valued)

SCIM provisioning (sample)
- Base endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/
- Example header: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9... (we'll generate a test token for the call)
- Provisioning mode: full CRUD (POST /Users, PUT /Users/{id}, PATCH /Users/{id}, DELETE /Users/{id})
- Group sync: PATCH /Groups and group membership is represented via members array (we map groups -> roles via attached CSV)
- Provisioning tokens: rotate every 90 days recommended; tokens can be limited to scope:scim:users scope and can be revoked from the Console

RBAC mapping notes
- Default role mapping in the CSV:
  - Vastly-Admins -> owner
  - Vastly-Engineers -> developer
  - Vastly-Viewers -> viewer
- Owners have full org-level controls including billing and admin creation; admins can manage teams and provisioning assignments

Audit & evidence
- Audit log exports: available as CSV for the last 12 months and available via our support portal for longer retention on request (we can provide a temporary export for your audit team).
- SOC 2: For your procurement team - Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025; Type II is scheduled and expected Q3 2026 (Marissa / Ops can share auditor & interim control matrix).

If you can share your Okta metadata link or upload the IdP metadata to the Drive link Marissa shared, we'll load it into a test tenant and generate the SCIM test token prior to the call.

If you prefer, here's a minimal test plan for the call:
1) Exchange metadata (IdP <-> SP).
2) Configure SCIM token in Redwood Console (we'll generate a test token).
3) Provision a single test user and confirm group -> role mapping.
4) Validate login via SAML (SP-initiated) and confirm attributes.

See you tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
